jobDescription: Profile- Sales Manager HVAC Location: Goa/Pune/Mumbai Experience: 7 yrs. + industrial exp. In A/c & Sales Salary: upto 9 lpa Working days- 6 days (10 am- 7 pm) Job Summary: The Sales Manager will lead the sales team and drive revenue growth for an HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) company. The Sales Manager will be responsible for developing sales strategies, managing key accounts, and achieving sales targets. This role requires strong leadership skills, a deep understanding of the HVAC industry, and a proven track record in sales management. Core Responsibilities: Resolve customer complaints regarding sales and service. Prepare budgets and approve expenditures. Heat Load calculations. Monitor customer preferences to determine the focus of sales efforts. Analyse sales statistics, Project sales and determine the profitability of products and services. Determine discount rates or special pricing plans. Develop plans to acquire new customers or clients, through direct sales techniques, cold calling, and business-to-business marketing visits. Assign sales territories and set sales quotas. Plan and coordinate training programs for sales staff. Responsibilities: 1. Sales Strategy and Planning: Develop and implement sales strategies and action plans to achieve company sales targets and objectives. Identify market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics to drive sales growth. Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities for business expansion. Collaborate with the management team to set sales targets and allocate resources effectively. 2. Team Management and Leadership: Lead, motivate, and manage the sales team to achieve individual and team sales targets. Provide coaching, training, and professional development opportunities to enhance the team's performance. Set clear sales goals, monitor performance, and provide regular feedback and performance evaluations. Foster a positive and collaborative team culture, encouraging teamwork and knowledge sharing. 3. Key Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key accounts, understanding their needs and ensuring customer satisfaction. Develop and implement strategies to expand business with existing clients and secure long-term partnerships. Conduct regular business reviews with key accounts to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling. Resolve customer issues or concerns promptly and effectively. 4. Business Development: Identify and pursue new business opportunities, target markets, and potential clients. Generate leads, conduct sales presentations, and negotiate contracts to secure new projects and clients. Collaborate with the marketing team to develop sales collateral, promotional materials, and targeted campaigns. Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to network and promote the company's products and services. 5. Sales Forecasting and Reporting: Monitor and analyse sales performance, market trends, and customer feedback to make data-driven business decisions. Prepare sales forecasts, budgets, and reports for the management team. Provide regular sales reports, including pipeline analysis, conversion rates, and revenue projections. 6. Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate with internal teams, including engineering, operations, and finance, to ensure smooth project handover and customer satisfaction. Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders, providing updates on sales activities, customer feedback, and market trends. Participate in sales and strategy meetings, contributing ideas and insights to drive business growth. Qualifications: B.E / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or related field. Proven experience as a sales Manager or in a similar sales leadership role within the HVAC industry. In-depth knowledge of HVAC systems, products, and services. Strong sales and negotiation skills, with a track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets. Excellent leadership, team management, and coaching abilities. Strong business acumen and strategic thinking. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders.

title: devops manager
jobDescription: Profile- Manager - DevOps Experience – Min 7+ years Ctc- upto 20 lpa – 30 LPA (Depend on the interview) Location: Bangalore Working days- 6 days (Rotational Shift) Job Description: Role Overview: As the DevOps Manager, you will play a crucial role in overseeing our DevOps team and ensuring the smooth operation of our infrastructure. You will be responsible for leading the team in implementing and managing DevOps best practices, automating processes, and optimizing our development and deployment pipelines. Additionally, you will be instrumental in configuring and maintaining our physical servers, AWS cloud infrastructure, and dedicated cloud servers. Key Responsibilities: Lead and mentor a team of DevOps engineers, providing guidance and support to ensure the successful execution of projects. Design and implement DevOps strategies, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing frameworks. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define infrastructure requirements and implement solutions that meet business needs. Configure and maintain physical servers, ensuring optimal performance, security, and scalability. Manage AWS cloud infrastructure, including provisioning, monitoring, and optimizing resources to meet performance and cost objectives. Administer and optimize dedicated cloud servers, ensuring high availability and reliability for our applications and services. Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. Continuously evaluate and recommend new tools, technologies, and processes to improve efficiency and productivity. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience (7 years) in a DevOps role, with a focus on managing infrastructure and leading teams. In-depth knowledge of DevOps principles and best practices, including CI/CD, automation, and infrastructure as code. Hands-on experience with configuring and maintaining physical servers, AWS cloud services, and dedicated cloud servers. Strong understanding of networking, security, and compliance requirements in a cloud environment. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong leadership and team-building skills, with a track record of successfully leading and mentoring DevOps teams. Preferred Qualifications: AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect). Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet. Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, etc.
